_comment: The competitive benchmark, as data rather than as a claim in a slide.
Rules this file is held to, enforced by knowledge/build-esrs.mjs:
1. Every vendor carries at least one source URL. No coverage assertion
2. Coverage is yes | partial | no | unknown. 'unknown' is the default and
is used whenever the vendor's own material does not say. Marking a
competitor 'no' because we did not find it is how benchmarks become
3. Our own row is graded on the same scale by the same rules, and every
'no' against us stays visible in the product.
This is a documentary review of published vendor material, not a product
trial. We have not run these platforms. Read it as 'what they say they do'.
method: Desk review of vendor and analyst material reachable from the build environment, August 2026. No platform was trialled.

capabilities.name: CSRD scoping
capabilities.why: Whether the company files at all, against the post-Omnibus thresholds.

capabilities.name: Double materiality
capabilities.why: The assessment that decides which topical standards are reported and which are omitted with a reason.

capabilities.name: Disclosure-requirement tracking
capabilities.why: Progress against named DRs rather than a single completion percentage.

capabilities.name: GHG inventory built in
capabilities.why: E1-6 is the largest quantitative disclosure in the standard. A CSRD tool that cannot produce the inventory sends you elsewhere for it.

capabilities.name: EU Taxonomy Article 8
capabilities.why: Mandatory alongside the ESRS narrative — turnover, CapEx and OpEx alignment KPIs.

capabilities.name: XBRL / iXBRL tagging
capabilities.why: The digital filing layer. Currently suspended, but the taxonomy exists and the mandate returns.

capabilities.name: ESRS ↔ IFRS S2 interoperability
capabilities.why: For the preparer filing under both, so the climate disclosure is built once.

capabilities.name: Assurance-ready audit trail
capabilities.why: Limited assurance is mandatory. Every figure needs provenance a reviewer can open.

capabilities.name: Published factor provenance
capabilities.why: Whether the emission factors behind the numbers are published with source, vintage and confidence — including the weak ones.

capabilities.name: Usable without a sales call
capabilities.why: Whether a preparer can get a real answer today without procurement.

capabilities.name: No data leaves the browser
capabilities.why: Whether the tool can be used on live commercial figures before a vendor has been cleared.

vendors.name: Workiva
vendors.position: The enterprise incumbent. Connected reporting platform linking financial and sustainability data in one audit-ready environment; iXBRL tagging built into the authoring workflow rather than run as a separate technical pass after sign-off.

sources.title: CSRD Software | Workiva CSRD Tools for Sustainability Reports
Use the ESRS XBRL taxonomy for sustainability reporting

vendors.note: The benchmark for tagging and for audit trail. Multi-framework collection across GRI, TCFD, SASB and CDP. GHG marked partial because the platform's stated strength is collecting and reporting the number rather than computing the inventory.

vendors.name: Position Green (with Greenomy)
vendors.position: European consolidator. Acquired Greenomy, adding digitised ESRS and EU Taxonomy reporting to its own reporting, carbon management, supply chain and advisory stack.

sources.title: Position Green Acquires Sustainability Reporting and Compliance Solutions Provider Greenomy

vendors.note: Greenomy's material states the official reporting template can be exported already filled out in Excel, PDF or XBRL, and that the ESRS and EU Taxonomy requirements are navigable in-product. Closest competitor to what this tool is trying to be, with a company behind it.

vendors.name: Cozero
vendors.position: EU-native carbon management and decarbonisation platform, positioned on European data residency with no US subprocessors.

sources.title: Workiva EU Alternative 2026: CSRD ESG Reporting Without CLOUD Act Exposure

vendors.note: Mostly unknown here, and left that way. The single reachable source is a comparison piece by another vendor, which is not a basis for asserting what Cozero does or does not do.

vendors.name: Sweep
vendors.position: Carbon and ESG data management, named repeatedly in CSRD software comparisons as an EU-native alternative.

sources.title: Workiva EU Alternative 2026: CSRD ESG Reporting Without CLOUD Act Exposure

vendors.note: Same caveat as Cozero. Listed because a benchmark that omits the obvious European names is not a benchmark.

vendors.name: Plan A
vendors.position: Carbon accounting and decarbonisation software with CSRD reporting positioning.

sources.title: Workiva EU Alternative 2026: CSRD ESG Reporting Without CLOUD Act Exposure

us.name: ReGenesis Impact

honest.why: Disclosure requirements are enumerated for ESRS 2 and E1 only. The other eight topical standards stay at standard level.

The Article 8 tool computes the three KPIs from activities you enter and applies the four gates. It does not carry the technical screening criteria per activity per objective — you assert whether each gate is met, and it records that assertion. A platform that ships the criteria does something we do not.
We assess tag-readiness and state where the mandate stands. We do not tag, and are not going to. Workiva does.
The assurance pack prints provenance, data quality and its own limitations. It is not a reviewer workflow with sign-offs and role separation, which is what an audit firm actually works in.

us.note: Where we win is narrow and real: every number opens to the factor behind it with source, vintage and confidence, including the four factors we cannot source; nothing leaves the browser; and there is no sales call. Where we lose is also real and is printed above rather than left out.
